nom: RMS Beauty SuperNatural Radiance Serum Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Sunscreen

avis.texte: I bought this at Blue Mercury, looking for a change from the Korean brand I usually use. It was thicker than I thought it would be, but I think very elegant feeling. Does not burn my eyes. A little bit of glow is a good thing, and it dries down nice but not to a dry matte. It doesn't feel heavy on my skin like a lot of sunscreens do. Creates a good base for my other makeup. My only issue is the price, it's a lot for what you get, and considering how much SPF you have to use every day, this bottle will be empty fast. I am glad I tried it but probably won't repurchase.
My absolute favorite! I use this everyday under my foundation and it adds a nice little glow ✨

I bought the medium and it was too dark for me. I am a light to medium skin tone. So I bought the light and I mix them together. PERFECT. It goes on my skin and settles beautifully into my skin not just on top. I wish for more colors to eliminate mixing.

avis.titre: Good sun protection with a nice glow
avis.texte: I am on my second bottle of this spf 30. It is so easy to apply and matches my skin color perfectly. It also gives my skin a nice glow. I am not walking around in the sun frequently but when driving long distances with the sun shining through the side window, I do not get pink or sunburned. Other sunscreens worn in the same way do not provide as much sun protection. I will continue to purchase this sunscreen.

avis.titre: A must have for my makeup bag
avis.texte: I love this product! I use it every day and especially during the summer months, it also serves as my foundation as well. It gives a beautiful glow and evens my skin while providing crucial SPF that I need every day.
The sunscreen goes on smoothly and leaves your skin having a natural glow. The whole time it's providing 30 SPF protection.

Creamy, feels fantastic on. I do wear sunscreen under it because I could never put enough on the get the 30 SPF effects, however, I really appreciate the extra SPF. I swear my skin improves using these products.
Loved the coverage. Very pigmented. A little goes a long long way. Maybe a shade of light/medium would be useful. I can easily leave off foundation when using this product.
I love this product! Great sheer coverage and it gives you a glowy finish. If you're a fellow pale girl "light aura" is perfection

This is a really nice tinted sunscreen, I wore it for the first time today. My skin still looked great after 8 hours of wear. I was worried it would be too light, and too luminous, but it's just perfect. My only issue with it is that if one uses the amount of sunscreen that is recommended for protection, you are going to go thru this small bottle pretty quickly.
I wear this everyday. I will use the light shade under my eyes for brightness and mis light and medium shade for all over tint and sun protection

avis.titre: The perfect glowy base for summer
avis.texte: I am a fan of spf stacking, and the fact that this adds some glow to my overall complexion before applying makeup too is a win-win. Blends seamlessly and creates a dewy, luminous base that feels perfect for the summertime. I have a light skin tone and the lightest shade works amazing.
This is a beautiful sunscreen that makes your skin glow! I wear it under the RMS tinted sunblock but am going to try it with the Hydra powder over it too. This is going to be great year round!
This is a very nice luminous sunscreen and it looks beautiful under the foundation. The quality of each product is beyond my dreams. Thank you, rms!!!

I love this serum. It goes on smooth and doesn't have that white cast to it. The tint is a very nice color, not too much. I wear it practically every day. Love the sun protection especially since it's summer. I've noticed it gives a nice glow to my skin.

I absolutely love these! To get the perfect shade I mix the light and medium. I only use this as "foundation" now with some concealer, blush, and powder over it. Really love how this makes you glow but not look overly made up.

Supernatural radiance is my favorite product of all 'foundations' on the market that I've tried. I started out using one tint all over but prefer using two - a lighter tint that matches my skin tone at the temples and below the eye, and a darker tint to highlight places the sun would normally touch your face. It really does look natural and stays on for hours.

avis.titre: The Magic of Light Aura Supernatural Radiance Serum!
avis.texte: I'm 59 with fair skin, and I recently purchased the Supernatural Radiance Serum in Light Aura. The older I get, the more my needs for my makeup foundation have really changed. Even in just the last couple of years, my primary goal of a foundation has changed, and I'm no longer primarily looking for coverage; I'm looking for products that leave me feeling well-hydrated with very little visible evidence of makeup on my skin. I've found that having texture and fine lines and age spots make traditional foundation way too obvious on the skin. I want my skin looking like my skin, MORE than I want complete coverage of dark spots and undereye circles (especially if it means SEEING my makeup as the price). That being said, comparing the (rms Supernatural Radiance) Serum to a couple of other similar products I've used (Supergoop and Kosas Dreambeam), the Serum is simply MAGICAL!! WOW! Does this look so lovely, and feel so amazing!! It provides this incredibly smooth finish to the skin, like nothing I've ever used before. I don't know how Rose Marie did it, create a lightweight, sheer product that actually EVENS out your complexion! And the glow. My goodness. The glow. But it's not sparkly, plus it really does provide such a beautiful finish. The only negatives I have to say: whyyyyy only 30 SPF???? 30 is just not enough for protection. I shouldn't have to feel like I need to wear something additional to bump up my SPF. It should be at the least 40 SPF. The other negative: for the categ
I love this product! It goes on smooth and gives such a nice touch of color and glow. I recommend it for anyone who'd like just a touch of color with their sunscreen.

avis.titre: At first I wasn't bowled over… But
avis.texte: …this is one of my stock up items now! You don't have to have flawless skin to love this product. It has a magical way of blurring imperfections, but making your natural skin look amazing! If you find it, it looks a little too shiny, get the Hydra loose powder and use a teeny tiny bit too Pat down the areas. You don't want to have shiny, and it will still look natural. The fact that it has SPF 30 is a great plus!
I'm in love with this product. Love it under my makeup in the light aura or sometimes mix in medium aura with a skin tint. Skin looks luscious

This is an absolutely beautiful product. I'm so happy I finally decided to try it. He hesitated because I typically do not like mineral sunscreens. But this formula is perfection. . . I use both the light and medium aura and I'm considering purchasing the rich to use for more of a bronze look. This product literally melts into your skin and wears beautifully alone or under makeup. It leaves the most perfect subtle radiance with very light coverage. I absolutely adore it. Highly recommend trying this. It's one of those products you have to try to understand. :)
Love the Radiance Serum. It goes on smoothly and is quite hydrating. It evens out my skin and leaves my face feeling dewey and ready for make up.
I absolutely love this product!! It creates a nice subtle glow
Love this clean, non white cast, moisturizing protection for my face. It leave a beautiful glow under my makeup.
I love this product. It goes on beautifully, nice and smooth.

This is my 2nd purchase of this product. I have very sensitive skin. This does not effect my sensitivity at all. I feel it leaves my skin flawless and glowing. It leaves a healthy natural glow. Will definitely keep purchasing. And I am 58 yo!
Love this on a no make up day- feels light but has a glowy effect. Minimal coverage, but I feel healthy with it on
Love this as a glowy spf base under makeup and also worn alone on an errands/gym day. I wouldn't wear it for waterproof or sweat proof spf protection but it's great for under makeup. 100% recommend!

avis.titre: Product great, packaging not so much
avis.texte: I love the light serum foundation and mix the medium with it in the summer. It gives a nice finish, not grease but a nice Dewey glow. However the bottle it comes in is hard and and to get the rest out (because I could not squeeze it) I had to cut it. I store it so the opening is down. When I cut into the bottle there was still quite a bit of product in there. Can this be put into a tube like toothpaste? I put the cut bottle in a baggy in the frig. I don't like the bottle at all.

The medium aura shade is a little darker than I expected but it looks nice on. The glow is gorgeous although I do feel it accentuates my pores. I find I get a more flawless look with 100% Pure's BB cream. I was expecting zero breakouts but I have seen some with consecutive days of use. Still, I'm glad to have found something clean with spf!

avis.titre: Love the tint and glow it gives.
avis.texte: Saving this for my vacation next week, but used it 2x before going to the pool. Really loved the glow it gives the skin and I didn't feel like I needed to add much in the way of coverage. I did add a little blush, but that was it. I feel like it is going to be perfect on my beachy/waterpark resort vacation. I'll know more after that.
Supernatural is my go to everyday foundation. Gives me the light makeup and fresh glow look that I like. It makes me happy:)

This spf doubles as a cc cream. It blurs and smooths out skin tone so well you don't really have to wear foundation to the pool or beach over top. No stinging as many spfs can do on the face. Beautiful product.

Absolutely love this! Has a good coverage with a glow!! My only issue is I feel there's not a lot of product in the bottle so I will be ordering again soon. I feel like I could wear the spy itself or normally. I'll use the loose powder on top of it. Really nice sunscreen.
Okayy I am in love with this product. Worn it by itself or under my foundation and both have worn amazingly. How it looks so radiant not greasy ill never know. But its wonderful!

avis.titre: Feels good and looks fabulous on skin.
avis.texte: I really love this product. I ordered the light color first and it's is too light for my complexion. Ordered the medium and it's too dark. Mix the two together and it's perfect.

RMS Radiance serum is the best product. I put very little on my cheek area over the sun block foundation. it looks so smoothing and hydrated with a natural glowing finish. Lasts all day. Will always purchase!
I love the light coverage and glow this gives me. My skin but better. I like mixing the light snd medium shades together.
It's okay probably wouldn't buy again. I love the tinted sunscreen much more.
I love this product! It is light weight, goes on smooth and makes my skin glow!

I wear this everyday. I either use it as a straight serum before moisturizer or I add it to my regular sunblock to give it a little shimmer. It's light, non greasy, and does not irritate my face the way many other sun protectants do.
I love the Supernatural Radiance Serum. I use the medium Aura mixed with the SunCoverup in Sand. The coverage is beautiful. My skin looks so healthy since I've been using RMS!

This serum is amazing! I actually wear it under the SunCoverup instead of foundation. I can't believe how well the products performed in extreme heat and humidity. It did take me awhile to figure out the best way to apply for the best results. I wish there were more shades available.

avis.titre: great product, don't like the bottle
avis.texte: I love this product, but I don't like the packaging. Once I couldn't squeeze any more product out, I cut open the bottle to see how much product was left. I was shocked to see how much was still left at the bottom and on the sides. It's a significant amount. I transferred it to a little silicone makeup container so it doesn't go to waste. RMS, please rethink the packaging!

This just makes my skin glow, and it works great as a primer. I put the beauty oil on first then the Supernatural Radiance Serum. So, it is not drying at all and I have dry skin. This is one of my favorite products from RMS!!!

This product is Amazing! It actually evens out my not so even skin tone. It also gives a subtle glow to your undertone. I Love all of my RMS products and knew that this would be great. However, it exceeded my expectations! You will love this, I guarantee it!!

avis.titre: Wonderful Product But Needs Better Container…
avis.texte: I ordered this in both the light and medium shade because the right color for me fell between the two. (Perhaps rms would consider making an additional shade in light/medium?). I put a stripe of each down my middle finger knuckle to tip and rub my fingers together to blend the tones, then smooth it all over my face and neck. It blends in quickly and easily and looks natural with a bit of luminosity but no "shimmer" of "glitter". I use this in place of any foundation and find I only need a bit of under eye concealer and some bronzer if I want to be an absolute minimalist. I do my eyes if I want to be public ready. This product is pricey but very high quality but the bottle it comes in is disappointing: it is too rigid to be able to squeeze out product if it is getting low. It would be much better if it came in a soft sided bottle or tube or even a glass bottle with dropper. I believe in the Fall I will probably go with the light version alone as I stop using a self tanner on my face once Summer ends.
I love the smooth texture when I apply this to my skin. It blends in well and gives me a natural, no-makeup base! I enjoy applying it every morning :)
This is a really nice sunscreen. I've used it under my RMS foundation. No pilling. No white cast even though it's light. It blends in nicely. I'd recommend it.

I love this sunscreen. It is more like a treat than skin protection. It gives a beautiful stain/ dewy finish. It dries down. and really holds anything that is put on top of it. I have two colors and the darker on is like a satiny subtle bronzer. Will repurchase (something I rarely do!) Oh. . . and customer service is just perfect. Very pleased
The serum is is like silk on your skin. The shimmer and SPF protection is a plus and you don't have to use a lot of product. Love it😁:+1::skin-tone-2:
I love that it's light texture lasts all through the day for me. Such a beautiful glow my skin has from the moment I apply!!
Love this product! Gives my skin a great healthy glow with spf protection. I put too much on at first. Use sparingly and build color.

avis.titre: This will be your holy grail product!!
avis.texte: The way this tinted sunscreen just makes my face glow and look flawless is beyond what I expected. I just this everyday over my rms hydrating mist and Kakadu Beauty Oil. My skin always looks so dewy and healthy. Holy grail product for me!

I tried the 50 spf from RMS this past year, but found that it's a little heavy coverage for my personal everyday preference. I came back to this one and love how lightweight it is, while still blurring imperfections. It's a great pair with the new under eye corrector for a simple, daily look! Thanks RMS! Photo features these two products, Babette liplights, mascara, and a discontinued gold glitter! The gold glitter is my favorite and I'd love to see it come back!

Wow! I can't go without this product! I use it as a primer. It helps even out redness, makes my skin incredibly dewy and fresh looking and has the added bonus of SPF 30! My foundation lasts all day too! Love!

I looked at this product a long time before i purchased. It feels a bit expensive to me……BUT WOW! It feels like 'sunscreen and makeup' in the same bottle! It gives my skin a glow that I just love, lasts a long time and the protection is reassuring. - I use sunscreen every single day, and I like it to be easy - this product is just great. Thinking about getting the next shade darker and mixing it.
I love this on its own or under a foundation. It's a wonderful, smooth formula that feels lovely. I like knowing that I have sun protection. It's absolutely got radiance, and is high quality.
Excellent product. This product blends in perfectly and brings shine to the face. Love how it lasts long.
This is one beautiful product. Nothing else comes close. It's addictive. Sunscreen is a bonus.

avis.titre: perfect with or without makeup SPF serum
avis.texte: Love this product… color great for fair skin. . emollient and appreciate that it has spf

This is the sunscreen I have been waiting for! I love the texture and it goes on sublimely! I love how it melts into my skin and makes it look so glowing yet covers what needs to be covered AND protects as well.

avis.titre: EXCELLENT Product! Especially for Mature Skin!
avis.texte: I absolutely LOVE this product! It is so luminous, moisturizing, light, and lovely! I love wearing by itself to just have a little glow and sun protection. But, I usually wear it as a base under my foundation for a little extra glow and smooth application. Absolutely LOVE!! For those looking for excellent products for mature skin, this is an EXCELLENT choice!
Beautiful coverage and protection. This is my second order of this great sunscreen.
I love this serum! Gives a wonderful luminous glow to my skin …like it's been sun kissed! Well definitely order this again! Love to see this in a bigger bottle.
I use this product alone or sometimes mix it with Sun CoverUp. The texture is nice, it lasts, and gives a bit of a glow to your face. I do wish I'd bought the light instead of medium.
This serum allows me to protect my skin and nourish it with ease each day.

Packaging is stiff, not pliable at all. It is very difficult to dispense the product because of this, and the tiny nipple through which the product is dispensed is useless. I have recommended the product to a number of friends who feel the same. The product is wonderful, but the packaging is a deal breaker. I have re-ordered once, but will not do so again.

A Soft Blendable Finish!!Wears Well& Feels Very Comfortable On The Skin!! Also Works Vey Well&Is Compatible W/Foundation,Etc. Atop!!Sun Protection Is A MUST&I'm Thrilled That Rose Marie Feels The Same!!It Is SO Worth Protecting Ur Skin As Its The Canvass That ALL Other Products Are Placed Atop!Skincare Is The Basis Of Any M-Up Application&I LOVE Rose Marie's Approach&Conviction 2 Both!!
I feel radiant wearing my new favorite summer base. I hate futzing over makeup and it's nice to apply and go!

I really like this Radiance SPF but I wish RMS offered more colors. I bought the medium aura; it says sheer but its too dark. Ideally I would need to mix the light and medium but at this price point, that's not reasonable to buy two shades.
Love this! Goes on and stays on beautifully! Definitely will always keep this on hand!
I am thrilled with this SPF serum. Such a plus it is mineral but blends in seamlessly with no white cast. Makes it so easy to use every day. No

I love how it looks and feels on my face. I where sunscreen everyday and I love that is a Clean product. It gives my skin a radiant glow and pairs well with the bronzer and lip to cheek blush. I chose the light due that I have fair skin.

avis.titre: Thin liquidy gel-like illuminating spf with iridescent sheer
avis.texte: I love this SPF. I have to mix light and medium to get my perfect shade. I have dry skin and zink in this product doesn't dry me out. It has more of a gel/light lotion thin consistency. Spreads easily and evenly into a thin layer, not patchy at all, but it gives enough sun protection and beautiful glowy illuminated bronzy color. Wears great all day on its own or can be used as a base. Doesn't get into lines or pores. Hey Rose-Marie, please create a color between light and medium!

I really wanted to love this product, but the shade range and undertones didn't work for my yellow/olive skin tone. Light Aura is too light and pulls pink on me, while Medium Aura is noticeably too orange. I even tried mixing the two shades together, but the undertones still looked off and didn't blend naturally with my complexion. That said, the formula itself is lovely. It applies smoothly, blends easily, and sets nicely without feeling greasy or overly dewy. I hope RMS expands the shade range in the future and offers more undertone options that work better across a wider variety of skin tones. Hope this helps my fellow yellow/olive-toned girlies who are considering this product!

I love these SPF serums-they're my favorite and I've tried the lightest and medium and love them for different reasons/occasions. They have a nice, light coverage and add that little bit of extra glow to the skin. Wear well under makeup as well.

I love this sunscreen. It goes on so soft and smooth and looks like skin with a beautiful luminosity that is not overwhelming. I can wear it alone or mix it with foundation. I am happy with the way it wears all day.

avis.titre: Sun protection with a beautiful glow
avis.texte: I love the quality of this sunscreen. It's like magic for the skin. Not only does it protect from the sun, but adds a beautiful luminosity to the skin.
My 2nd time purchasing this sunscreen. It's wonderful on its own and plays well under makeup, especially RMS products. :grinning:
This offers added SPF protection under my RMS foundation. It goes on smoothly and enhances my makeup. This arrived very quickly and I have been extremely happy with this purchase.

Ok this product surprised me. I really was expecting it to be greasy like any other sunscreen product and its NOT!! im so in loveee!! Its perfect. Literally smooths/evens out the skinttone and just you look amazing. Its perfect! As always rose Marie does it again knocking it out the park!

I can't say enough good about this product!! I love the sheen and tint of this product and use by itself for a no make-up day. Sunscreen is vital where I live, and I welcome this new addition to my RMS collection of great products.

I loveeee these! I have both the light and medium aura. They make my skin so glowy. I've had issues with it caking sometimes(mainly the medium aura) but it's not always so I think it has to do with the moisture of my skin. These provide great all day coverage. Only thing is, I wish there was a tone in between light and medium. The light is basically ghostly white and the medium is very brown. I need something right in the middle. I usually mix the 2 so my skin tone isn't glowing the wrong color.

Love, Love, Love the Super Radiance Serum! It looks amazing on my skin and it is so hydrating. I highly recommend it for aging skin. I have the foundation and tinted sunscreen as well. I find myself wearing my RMS Primer, the brightening concealer with the metal ball, then I use a light coat of this Serum. It gives me the perfect coverage without having to wear anything else except my blush and luminizer on my skin! I have been an Esthetician for 37 years and have taken care of my skin. These products gives me the glow that you can usually only get by piling on multiple products!

I love this product! I use it every single day and have since bought refills because I cannot be without it. I prefer this to the 50 spf skin tint. It gives a beautiful glow to the skin and has just enough tint to even out the skin tone. I like to mix the light and medium in the summer and just use the light in the winter when I am pale so that it always matches my skin tone. I find it applies well, does not pill and makeup goes on evenly over this product. Highly recommend!

I love the coverage but the plastic bottle has degraded and leaves small plastic pieces on my fingers when I handle it which if I wasn't careful would then end up in the serum on my face. Please change your packaging!

I love this product. It is so easy to apply. The soft glow that it adds to my skin enhances my color and looks so natural. The best part is the SPF factor. I know that my skin is protected at all times. I feel like it takes ten years off of my face. You cannot go wrong with this product. I highly recommend it.
The results are amazing. I definitely feel the protection and I love the visual effects on my skin!
I am loving all of the products that I have bought. For the first time in my life I have a makeup routine that is easy

Love the look, texture and feel of this sun protecting serum. My husband complimented me on my skin he thought I had just had a facial after several hours of wearing. It's easy to use, wear and has minimal scent upon application. I have the light shade for when I don't have a tan and medium after I get a good base tan.
This radiance serum is amazing. I love how smooth it applies and amazing my skin looks under my makeup

This sunscreen gives my skin a luminous glow. I combine the light and medium shades to get a perfect match with my skin. Since I started wearing this product I've received so many compliments on my skin!

For 2 years this SPF is my all time fave daily "foundation"! I truly appreciate a glow these days vs full coverage. I'm 46 and am embracing my natural skin these days. It's definitely not full coverage, but I feel put together and glowy everyday now, and my makeup routine is 5 minutes with this SPF, plus creamy blush, RMS eye lights, RMS eyebrow powder, and some mascara and I'm done. I have light skin and I mix the light and medium shade together!!
Doesn't really apply well. Also seems to get absorbed quickly and doesn't keep the tent it cake certain in areas. Also not great match with my skin tone. It's a bit too dark.

avis.titre: Protect your face and look great!
avis.texte: Protect my face every day with this spf 30. Sunblock always burned and looked ugly on my face. Now I have protection and coverage.

RMS Supernatural Radiance could be the best product I have used on my skin. It gives great sun protection (proven in the Caribbean) and leaves a natural fresh glow. It stays put and feels luxurious. Thank you RMS!

Pros: love the light fragrance, no white cast, feels light and lovely Cons: The plastic container is a nightmare to get product out of especially towards the end. Makes my eyes burn within an hour or so!!!;-(
Love the product, hate the package. So hard to get the product out of this bottle, especially when you have less in it. Please consider changing the package

avis.titre: Glowy vibrance / would love more shades
avis.texte: Love this stuff! It creates a glowy vibrance and has a nice creamy feel. Like some other reviewers, I would love if there was a shade between light and medium. I generally wear medium shades of foundation but on the lighter side. I mix the two shades which works well.
I have never used sunscreen on my face until now. I love the radiance of this product. I have put it on over and under my foundation. Beautiful look!

love the glow and the coverage! works so well and keeps me from getting pink! especially love the fact that my face does not get white from the ingrediants. just saw a video of Rose Marie applying the radiance serum over the top of the reevolve radiance locking primer and that combination feels and looks great! sun protection has never felt and looked so good!
This is my fav!!! It's a tinted sunscreen that is also nourishing good for your skin! I mix the light with the medium. It feels great and leaves a dewy finish.
Great sunblock. It goes on well and the light tint works for my skin color.
Love wearing this SPF on non-makeup days. Goes on smoothly and is non-irritating for my very sensitive skin. Will purchase again
This is another home run product. light, beautiful finish and skin protective. I am so glad I found RMS!

avis.titre: Where has this been all me life?!
avis.texte: I love it! I found my perfect product after over 100 tries. It js skin care, luminosity, with natural but better finish. It has the spf I need, moisture, and it with a little of your new eye concealer with spf (well and your hydra blush, highlighter, eye lights, mascara, CHAMELION lip oil with nude pencil, and a touch to the brow) and I am a beautiful force of nature on any day!!! At 57 I need very little other coverage past thus awesome product. . . I know that's not it's purpose. Highly recommend

I'm still figuring out how much I like this sunblock. It has a beautiful hue with easy application. It doesn't feel greasy. I just wish it had a little better coverage. I haven't tried layering it yet, but it might be a nice under layer.
I have just begun to use the Very small package of Radiance serum. I like the texture and color but really it is small! I would say overpriced.

I've been using this sunscreen for over 2 years. As a redhead whose dad has had multiple melanomas, sunscreen is a daily must. I've tried so so many and this is the first I've found that checks all the boxes- lightweight, non greasy, tinted, great coverage and feels fantastic on my skin.

Such a pretty color. I wasn't sure if it would look too "shimmery" but it doesn't. It gives an amazing glow to my face and I use it alone, or under some concealer. So pretty and perfect for spf protection.

I've used 3 bottles of this and I will keep repurchasing. It's the best glowy sunscreen. My skin is oily, textured and acne prone and this gives me a natural, more even looking glow while giving the sun protection I need and not getting gross and oily. Beautiful.
Love it! Natural and doesn't settle in lines at all. I love the fact that it is a very clean product.

I like the shades. I use them when I'm in hurry and just need a little glow . I really appreciate the clean ingredients. Currently getting rid of toxic makeup and purchasing things that are healthier in my skin. This is a good quality item and would recommend.

I cannot live without this product! It's the perfect combination of sun protection and lightweight coverage, and it evens out my complexion so naturally. I don't even need foundation when I use this — even my red areas are noticeably toned down (with a little concealer where needed, of course). It feels light on the skin, looks natural, and somehow still gives great coverage. Truly a heaven-sent gift for my skin!
